Definition: from G61; to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap:--catch.
BiblicalUsage: Agreuo means to hunt — to catch or entrap — and it appears once, in the trap set for Jesus: 'they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.' The word is a hunter's word: they were not asking a question, they were laying a snare, hoping His own answer would be the rope. The tribute question was the bait.
TheologicalSignificance: They came to catch Him in His words, and this word names the trap — the Lord's answer is the teaching, not the verb.
